summary: Release direct mouse-drag movement reliably when WebKit omits Phaser's pointerup delivery.

spec.reason: Direct drag movement and multi-touch pointer ownership behavior are unchanged.

design.reason: A window mouseup fallback complements the existing Phaser pointerup, pointercancel, gameout, and blur release paths.

validation: The unchanged browser drag test still requires real pointer input, Phaser right-key state, natural-loop player movement, and zero horizontal velocity after release.
The multi-touch test still requires a second pointer not to steal the active drag and only the owner release to clear touch movement.
The natural drag/release flow passed 20 of 20 serial WebKit repetitions after the fallback was added.
Side Scroller lint, typecheck, build, and all 141 unit tests passed.
limitations: Physical iOS and Android devices remain unverified.
